per_window.ps-ns: dynamic_in_window: apo WT hinges and lids show ps–ns fluctuations (low-S2 hotspots at hinges, growing from 20 to 80 °C; J3, rows r13–r15); the 80 °C no-glycerol rigidity is a diagnosed analysis artefact (J4, r16). Apo MD rows r26 and r27 (10 ns) agree with the S2 pattern but were not judged separately.
per_window.us-ms: dynamic_in_window in every WT state measured with Mg or without ligand: apo 10 °C kex 950 ± 150 s-1 (J1, r1); apo 20 °C 2,000–7,000 s-1 (J2, r2); Mg-ADP turnover 20 °C kex 1,615 s-1 with kopen 44 s-1 (J8, r9; five Table 1 residues); Mg-AMPPNP/AMP 1,410 s-1 (J10, r10, r12; seven Table 1 residues); Mg-Ap5A 300 s-1 with 95% closed (J11, r3; 46 residues in SI Table S4); turnover at 50 °C > 10,000 s-1 (J9, r11). Labelled-construct smFRET agrees (J7, J12). Mg-free nucleotide-bound enzyme is measured_not_detected (J13, r19), with E. coli homolog support only (flat at 20 °C, J14, r20; slow-limit exchange at 40 °C, J17, r21). Apo WT residue sets (J1, J2) are figure only (Fig. 3c; Supplementary Fig. S6), so the apo judgments stay unlocalized.
per_window.slower_than_ms: not_measured for WT apo (J16; HDX-MS, EPR/DEER, time-resolved searched with no hits). Only a force-tethered Mg-Ap5A construct gives a ~1 s-1 opening (J15, r22). Mg-free lid opening is implied to be slower than the CPMG window, but no Aquifex rate exists (J13).
per_window.undetermined: Apo crystal substates and the apo-versus-Ap5A structures (J5, r7, r8) and PRE closed-like contacts in the spin-labelled construct (J6, r4) show lid heterogeneity without a timescale. Not judged: active-site structures r17, r18; bound-state, coarse-grained and QM/MM MD r28–r32; tweezer ADP/ATP partial-closure rows r23, r24; optoplasmonic sensor rows r34–r36; activity row r33; E. coli, P. profundum and G. stearothermophilus appendix rows r25 and s1–s12 (homolog only).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Yes: apo WT Aquifex Adk shows μs–ms exchange in the hinges and parts of both lids, with a global kex of 950 ± 150 s-1 at 10 °C (perdeuterated) and faster exchange (2,000–7,000 s-1 compatible) at 20 °C; NMR cannot give the minor-state population because the dispersions are small, while PRE and smFRET on labelled constructs point to a closed-like minor state.
questions_for_gina: Which sample does the RelaxDB AQADK_CPMG R2eff/νCPMG set come from: the 10 °C perdeuterated apo data (kex 950 s-1), the 20 °C protonated apo data, or the 20 °C Mg-ADP turnover data of Wolf-Watz 2004 (kex 1,615 s-1)?
For the WT apo minor state, should the atlas leave pB undetermined (NMR amplitudes too small), or carry the closed-like assignment from the labelled PRE/smFRET constructs as inference_from_mutant?
protein_summary.buffer_note: All Aquifex NMR samples used 40 mM MOPS (pH 7.0, 50 mM NaCl) because the authors found that Adk binds phosphate with a dissociation constant of about 1 mM, causing large chemical shift changes, and so avoided phosphate buffer (AQADK-r9; the source sentence does not name the species).

Supplementary Tables S1-S4 of nature06410 (MOESM269) hold no apo residue list (S1-S3 crystallography, S4 Mg-Ap5A shifts), and Nature 2007 has no Source Data file.

judgments.function_link: kopen 44 ± 20 s-1 matches kcat 30 ± 10 s-1, so the authors identify lid opening as rate-limiting for Aquifex turnover at 20 °C.
